title: V2: Preserve v1 and ship the Phaser survival foundation on GitHub Pages
body:
Preserve the original real-time enemy swarm design and existing Fire Emblem assets.

Acceptance criteria:
- Archive existing game and controller source under v1, including local edits.
- Scaffold Phaser 3, TypeScript strict mode and Vite.
- Playable character selection, movement, melee, waves, damage, pickups, pause and clean restart.
- Automated rules and browser smoke tests pass.
- Deploy a verified build to https://joncady.github.io/feadventures/ using GitHub Actions.

This is the initial migration slice. Full feature parity is tracked separately.

title: V2: Port directional movement and attack sprite animations
body:
The initial migration uses the standing-row animation frames from the original 200×492 sprite sheets.

Acceptance criteria:
- Define exact frame boundaries for all original directional and attack rows.
- Port movement, facing, idle and attack animations for Chrom, Lucina, Frederick and all enemies.
- Preserve the last facing direction when attacking from idle.
- Verify there is no frame bleeding at scaled resolutions.

title: V2: Add obstacle-aware swarm navigation
body:
The foundation uses direct pursuit with Arcade Physics terrain collisions. Enemies can become blocked behind the original map obstacles.

Acceptance criteria:
- Derive a navigation grid from map geometry.
- Route melee enemies around obstacles toward the living player.
- Bound and stagger path recalculation as swarm sizes increase.
- Verify all spawn regions can reach the player and spawning never occurs inside terrain.
- Add tests for blocked paths and unreachable targets.

Current local status: Local implementation now includes a shared terrain-expanded navigation field, reachable-only spawns and unit/browser tests. Still unpublished; large-swarm profiling and congestion checks remain.

title: V2: Restore enemy combat roles and ranged projectiles
body:
The initial migration renders all five original enemy types but uses contact damage for each. Restore the distinct original combat roles.

Acceptance criteria:
- Archer keeps distance and fires arrows with directional visuals.
- Melee enemies use configurable range, damage and attack cooldowns.
- Projectiles collide with terrain and players and expire cleanly.
- Enemy attacks telegraph clearly and cannot damage after death or scene shutdown.
- Verify projectile cleanup across wave transitions and repeated restarts.

Current local status: Local implementation now includes aimed archer projectiles, terrain collisions, timed/dodgeable melee windups, per-type cooldowns and regression tests. Still unpublished; animation and balance parity remain.

title: V2: Restore local co-op and evaluate browser controller support
body:
The original game attempted two-player keyboard input and a separate GameCube adapter server. The initial migration is single-player.

Acceptance criteria:
- Support at most two selected players with separate input bindings.
- Support living-player targeting and end the game only when everyone is dead.
- Add browser Gamepad API input with connection and disconnection handling.
- Test the actual GameCube adapter in supported browsers; retain an optional local bridge only if browser support requires it.
- The hosted game must run without a localhost server for keyboard play.

title: V2: Migrate map progression and data-driven waves
body:
The foundation uses the original first map and increasing enemy counts. Expand content through typed data instead of scene-specific branching.

Acceptance criteria:
- Port remaining map assets with collision definitions and safe player spawns.
- Configure enemy mixes, wave budgets, spawn cadence and pickup frequency per stage.
- Provide an explicit stage transition and progress display.
- Test that a cleared wave advances exactly once and final map behavior is defined.

title: V2: Expand browser regression coverage and performance checks
body:
Keep the github.io game playable as migration features are added.

Acceptance criteria:
- Cover movement displacement, terrain collisions, directional melee and wave progression in browser tests.
- Cover repeated deaths/restarts, hero reselection, pause/resume and tab focus changes.
- Test asset loading under /feadventures/ as well as a site root.
- Profile large swarms and set a practical enemy cap.
- Add Firefox and WebKit coverage where supported, with CI failures blocking publication.

title: V2: Add touch controls and accessible gameplay settings
body:
The initial migration scales its canvas but requires a keyboard. Improve input and usability for the public browser build.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add touch movement and attack controls without obscuring combat.
- Add separate music/effects levels and persist preferences.
- Support remappable keyboard controls and a reduced-motion option.
- Verify menus are usable with keyboard focus and narrow screens.
- Show a clear loading failure/retry state when assets cannot be loaded.

title: V2: Reconcile legacy balance, pickups and battle start parity
body:
Compare archived v1 with the current local build before further publication. Current gaps: player damage 10 vs 35, changed enemy stats/timing, kill drops vs rare timed pickups, missing stage countdown, changed wave counts/cadence.
Acceptance criteria:
- Record each original/current value and choose restoration or an explicitly accepted design change.
- Restore countdown/start gating, pickup behavior and wave rules where required.
- Verify parity with gameplay tests and update docs/parity.md.
- Keep implementation local; do not push or deploy until parity is approved.

title: V2: Define shared unit, faction and weapon profiles
body:
Prerequisite for NPC soldiers, player archers, Morgan, weapon effectiveness and flight. Current player attack is hard-coded as one sword strike, and enemies target one scene.player.
Acceptance criteria:
- Separate character identity, class, weapon, faction and ground/flying movement.
- Define min/max attack range, damage kind (physical/magical), windup, recovery, cooldown and projectile behavior in typed data.
- Route player/enemy/ally attacks through shared damage and targeting rules; select living hostile targets with stable target switching.
- Preserve current attacks and local tests; bound navigation work when multiple targets exist.
- Treat pixel ranges/timings as real-time balance values, not literal Awakening tile distances.
Reference: https://serenesforest.net/awakening/miscellaneous/calculations/

title: V2: Add allied NPC soldiers that fight and attract enemies
body:
User priority: P1. Reuse default enemy sprite sheets for allied soldiers with an unmistakable allied marker/health bar.
Depends on shared unit/faction/weapon profiles.
Acceptance criteria:
- Spawn a bounded set of allied NPC soldiers in reachable terrain; they seek and attack living enemies with range, telegraph and cooldown checks.
- Enemies can choose soldiers or players using distance/threat and target-switch hysteresis; soldiers attract attacks without every enemy being permanently diverted.
- Enemy arrows and melee damage the intended hostile faction; no friendly fire by default.
- Handle target death, navigation for different targets, pause, restart and all-player defeat; NPC survival does not prevent game over.
- Allies do not count toward enemy wave-clear totals or award player pickup/kill credit accidentally.
- Test targeting, damage, death cleanup and bounded swarm performance.

title: V2: Add weapon triangle and attack effectiveness rules
body:
Implement Awakening-inspired weapon matchups, distinct from unit-type effectiveness.
Sword beats axe; axe beats lance; lance beats sword. Bows and tomes are neutral in this triangle. Awakening triangle modifies hit and, at higher weapon ranks, attack; decide/document a deterministic adaptation rather than silently importing Fates/Heroes rules.
Bows and wind tomes are effective against flying units. Other effectiveness requires weapon-specific tags (e.g. armor/cavalry/dragon), not blanket magic-vs-armor bonuses. Physical damage checks defense; magical damage checks resistance. Awakening effectiveness triples weapon Might, not final damage.
Acceptance criteria:
- One pure tested damage resolver handles player, enemy and allied attacks consistently.
- Separate weapon family, damage kind, effectiveness tags and defensive stats.
- Show advantage/weakness clearly and test neutral types, opposite matchups, stacked effects and minimum damage.
- Balance against current local stats and record departures from Awakening.
Sources: https://serenesforest.net/awakening/miscellaneous/calculations/ ; https://serenesforest.net/awakening/inventory/bows/ ; https://serenesforest.net/awakening/inventory/tomes/

title: V2: Add a playable archer with weapon-specific range
body:
Suggested first character: Virion (selection subject to verified map-sheet availability); Noire is an alternative. Reuse the tested enemy arrow pipeline through shared projectile code.
Awakening standard bows have range 2 and cannot attack adjacent units; Longbow has range 2-3. These are tile rules; our game needs a documented pixel interpretation.
Proposed real-time design: movement sets last facing; Space fires in that direction, with a readable aim line and configurable maximum range. Preserve a close-range weakness, starting with a minimum targeting distance; decide whether already-fired arrows may hit nearer enemies. No hidden automatic melee fallback.
Acceptance criteria:
- Add character selection, portrait and verified directional/attack frames.
- Shared player arrow collision, enemy/ally faction rules, expiry, terrain blocking and audio.
- Display min/max range and test point-blank policy, facing while idle, pause and restart.
- Apply flying effectiveness when such units are present.
Sources: https://serenesforest.net/awakening/inventory/bows/ ; https://www.spriters-resource.com/3ds/fireemblemawakening/

title: V2: Add magic attacks with Morgan as the first mage
body:
User-selected first magic player: Morgan. Choose a verified Morgan map sprite/portrait and explicit tome-capable class/loadout; gender/class availability is an asset/design decision, not a reason to change the requested character.
Most Awakening tomes have range 1-2 and use Magic against Resistance. Fire/Thunder/Wind are not a rock-paper-scissors magic triangle in Awakening; wind tomes have flying effectiveness.
Proposed first slice: Fire tome, visible cast windup, directional bolt and cooldown; no automatic area damage, mana or elemental status system assumed. Add Wind later through weapon data.
Acceptance criteria:
- Morgan selectable with verified frame map, casting state, spell visual and sound.
- Shared projectile/range/faction/cleanup rules and magical damage resolver.
- Configurable close and medium range, with a visible range cue.
- Test resistance vs defense, obstacle policy, cast interruption on death, pause and restart.
Sources: https://serenesforest.net/awakening/inventory/tomes/ ; https://serenesforest.net/awakening/miscellaneous/calculations/ ; https://www.spriters-resource.com/3ds/fireemblemawakening/

title: V2: Add a flying Pegasus Knight player
body:
Suggested first character: Sumia or Cordelia after verifying the map sprite. Add lance attack and flying movement through shared profiles.
User requirement: fly above terrain. Separate low terrain that can be overflown from hard walls/world boundaries; do not disable all collisions globally. Ground AI must still behave sensibly while a flying target is over an unreachable area.
Acceptance criteria:
- Flying render depth/shadow and readable movement/attack state.
- Traverse designated terrain while retaining world boundaries and attack collisions.
- Define flight height/ground melee reach and projectile occlusion explicitly; flight must not create unintended permanent invulnerability.
- Bows and wind magic exploit flying weakness.
- Test switching targets to reachable NPCs and chasing a flyer returning to walkable ground.
Sources: https://www.spriters-resource.com/3ds/fireemblemawakening/ ; https://fireemblem.fandom.com/wiki/Pegasus_Knight ; https://serenesforest.net/awakening/inventory/bows/ ; https://serenesforest.net/awakening/inventory/tomes/

title: V2: Add directional blocking and verify guard sprite options
body:
Awakening has chance-based allied Dual Guard that negates a hit; it is not a manual player block button. A manual guard is an intentional real-time adaptation.
Proposed first slice: hold a configurable key to guard the facing arc, reduce physical damage, slow movement and disable attacks; use a bounded guard meter or recovery to prevent indefinite holding. Magic bypasses ordinary guard initially unless a ward is explicitly added. Exact values require playtesting.
Acceptance criteria:
- Define front/back arc, melee/arrow behavior, repeated hits and resource recovery.
- Use a verified guard frame if present; otherwise reuse idle pose with a code-rendered shield arc/impact flash and mark the asset gap. No dedicated guard sheet has been verified from the linked catalog.
- Shared damage handling for guard and weakness interactions.
- Test attack/guard exclusion, rear hits, magic policy, pause/death/restart and input remapping.
- Keep optional NPC-triggered Dual Guard separate from this manual mechanic.
Sources: https://serenesforest.net/awakening/miscellaneous/calculations/ ; https://www.spriters-resource.com/3ds/fireemblemawakening/
